2682.title: Project source updates do not repair a missing Git remote
2682.rootCauseOneLine: The source-update route writes the source but omits the existing host inspection and guarded remote backfill.
2682.proposedFix: Inspect the updated local source and call the existing null-guarded remote setter before the route returns.
2682.caveats: The direct reproduction uses the server test harness and a simulated successful host inspection.
